categories.name: Employment law
categories.description: Changes that affect employers and staff.

posts.title: New notice periods from January 2027
posts.excerpt: Minimum notice for staff with five or more years of service rises next year. What employers should change now.
posts.content:
From 1 January 2027 the minimum notice period for staff with five or more years of service rises from four to six weeks.

Check contracts and handbooks that quote the old figure, and budget for longer notice in any restructuring planned for next year.

posts.title: A checklist for renewing a commercial lease
posts.excerpt: Six points to check at least nine months before your lease ends.
posts.content:
Start nine months early. Check the break clause, the rent review basis, repair obligations and who pays for the fit-out.

We review a lease and send a one-page summary for a fixed fee.

posts.title: Shareholder agreements for two-founder companies
posts.excerpt: What to agree before the first investor arrives: vesting, deadlock and leaver terms.
posts.content:
Most founder disputes we see come from three missing clauses: vesting, deadlock and what happens when one founder leaves.

A short agreement signed early costs far less than a dispute later.
